description: This file defines in-memory representations of a workbook and its sheets, supporting multiple sheets, basic cell access/edit, and header-aware column operations. It provides classes for workbook and sheet models with methods for manipulating and querying sheet data.

classes.name: InMemoryWorkbook
classes.description: Represents a workbook containing multiple sheets with methods to access sheet names and retrieve sheets by name.

classes.name: SheetModel
classes.description: Represents a sheet within a workbook, managing rows and columns, with methods for cell access, modification, and header operations.

methods.name: sheetNames
methods.description: Returns the list of sheet names.

methods.name: getSheetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a sheet model by its name.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the sheet.

methods.name: colCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of columns across all rows.

methods.name: ensureSize
methods.description: Ensures the sheet has at least targetRows rows and targetCols columns, adding nulls as needed.

methods.name: getCell
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cell at specified row and column.

methods.name: setCell
methods.description: Sets the value of a cell at specified row and column.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns the header row as a list of strings, converting nulls to empty strings.

methods.name: findColumnIndexByName
methods.description: Finds the index of a column by name (case-insensitive), trimming whitespace.
